explanation: Keep one entry from each nonempty sorted array in a min-heap and track their maximum. Advancing the array that supplied the minimum is the only way to improve the current range; stop when one array is exhausted.
timeComplexity: O(N log(k+1)) for N examined entries and k arrays
attribution: Original Python implementation authored for EPI Practice from its displayed contract and independently authored C# solution; no upstream reference source adapted.
